polityNote: Central African Republic since 1960-08-13 (Central African Empire 1976-12-04 to 1979-09-21). Law 96-013 (1996) provided 7 regions above prefectures, but regions were not implemented; prefectures stayed the functioning first level (Répertoire). The 2020-12 reform to 20 prefectures is outside scope. Atoms: the 72 sub-prefectures of geoBoundaries CAF ADM2 (UNHCR 2015, CC BY 3.0), rewritten from Natural Earth on 2026-10-06 so that Sangha-Mbaéré can be split into its Haute-Sangha part (Nola, Bayanga) and its Lobaye part (Bambio) for 1960–1974; every prefecture is the union of the sub-prefectures that the NE prefecture atom holds (all assignments ≥ 0.65 of area, 70 of 72 ≥ 0.9). ① 1968 published areas (statoids) vs unions: Lobaye 24,500 vs 24,170 km² (0.987); Haute-Sangha 44,360 vs 41,504 (0.936); Kémo-Gribingui 37,210 vs 36,321 (0.976).
